name: Joyce Randall
office: Inglewood Unified School District, Member, Board of Education, Trustee Area 1

items.text: Joyce Randall is the incumbent Board of Education member for Inglewood Unified, representing Trustee Area 1 since her election in November 2022. She has over 31 years of experience as a teacher, mentor teacher, and STEAM magnet school coordinator. She currently teaches health in the Los Angeles Unified School District. She has led the Inglewood Council of PTAs and La Tijera School PTA, chaired the Inglewood Teachers Association’s grievance committee, and served as a National Education Association delegate. She also directed education at a megachurch and served on its school board. Her campaign says she aims to resolve the district’s debt, work with community stakeholders, and continue holding town hall meetings.
